$comment: Origin of the HOLLOW SUN props (decision D34): a concept from GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst on a transparent background, turned into a textured mesh by Meshy 7.1 image to 3D (remeshed, triangles, PBR), both on Scenario Pro (commercial licence) through the Scenario MCP, then processed by scripts/blender/hollowsun_char.py (SPECS). Every prompt ended with the shared style and asked for one isolated object in a three-quarter view; no names of artists, games or brands.

PR_crypt_pillar.prompt: A single broken gothic stone column, carved fluted shaft with an eclipse sun relief, cracked capital, rubble at its square base, soot stains and faint ember glow in the cracks

PR_crypt_wall.prompt: A ruined section of an old stone wall with a jagged broken top, fallen blocks and rubble at its foot, faint ember glow in deep cracks

PR_crypt_lantern.prompt: A tall wrought iron lantern post on a small stone base with a hooked arm holding a caged lantern with a warm flame

PR_crypt_chest.prompt: A closed treasure chest of dark aged wood bound with blackened iron straps and bronze corner plates, a heavy lock with an eclipse sun emblem

PR_crypt_brazier.prompt: A standing iron brazier, a wide shallow bowl on three curved legs filled with glowing coals, bronze rim decorated with sun rays

PR_crypt_arch.prompt: A free-standing gothic stone archway gate, two thick square pillars joined by a pointed arch with a carved eclipse sun keystone, an empty opening, cracked stone with a faint ember glow

PR_kiln_anvil.prompt: A gigantic blacksmith anvil of dark iron on a massive stepped stone plinth, glowing molten cracks, heavy chains wrapped around the plinth
